svg.title: Finance and payroll | Implementation class collaboration

g.text: Finance and payroll | Implementation class collaboration
Class diagram uses real ORM/dataclass/protocol concepts.
Module boxes are functions, not invented service classes.
Payroll has no call to Finance and does not transfer funds.
Receipt identifiers are logical references, not SQL foreign keys.
Multiplicity describes the unique-per-invoice business rule.
Dashed arrow: dependency (uses, creates or returns)
Dashed line + hollow triangle: realization of PaymentGateway
Python adapters satisfy the protocol structurally; no runtime inheritance is implied.
No aggregation/composition is asserted without a matching ownership lifecycle.
